title: A month after crossing 800 million transactions a day, UPI just broke its own record again. November 11, 2026.
excerpt: From independent India's first Education Minister to UPI's latest all-time record, November 11's two stories are about systems built to keep getting bigger than the records they just set.
bodyHtml:
Today's two stories are 138 years apart but share the same shape: an institution built once that keeps outgrowing its own previous ceiling.

He became Congress president at 35 - then spent over a decade building the system that still educates India today

Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, born November 11, 1888, became the youngest-ever Congress president at 35 and later held the longest presidential term in Congress history. After independence, he served as India's first Education Minister for over a decade, laying the foundations of India's modern education system - work honoured every November 11 as National Education Day.

A month after crossing 800 million transactions a day, UPI just broke its own record again

UPI processed a record 25.47 billion transactions worth Rs 31.53 lakh crore in October 2026 - and for the first time ever, the average daily transaction value crossed Rs 1 lakh crore. That's up from September's 24.07 billion transactions, with year-on-year volume growth of roughly 23%.

Two stories, one pattern: an education system built to outlast its founder, and a payments system that treats every record as a floor, not a ceiling.
